title: A Title track and a Gfx track wear the icons the title mock draws
goal: In the title walkthrough mock, the Title track header shows a text mark and the Gfx track a sparkle, so the kind of track reads at a glance. Today both show the same stacked-layers icon that every track laid over the picture wears, so a title track and a logo track look alike apart from their names.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-title-wt.html lines ~372-378 (#trackGfx ic-sparkle, #trackTitle ic-text). Code: TimelineTrackRow.symbol(_:) in Sources/Photonz/TimelineTrackRows.swift (overlay = square.3.layers.3d, text = textformat) and the trackKind the header row is given (~line 1238). Seen in the audit pictures of a-title-or-a-logo-laid-over-a-video-lands-on-a-t (2026-10-16): Gfx and Title 2 headers both show the layers icon. Check video.html too, which may use ic-layers for overlay tracks, before choosing.
acceptance: A track holding a title (Title, Title 2) shows the text mark in its header, as video-title-wt.html draws it
A track holding a picture laid over the video (Gfx) shows the sparkle mark in its header
A walk at Next defaults photographs both headers beside V1

log.note: Cause: a preset title is a group and a placed logo is an image, so both fell through to TimelineTrackKind.overlay (stacked layers). Fix: a title group (titleRecipe) is .text; an image with its own time is a new .graphic kind (sparkles); an image with no time stays .overlay. Title clips now draw the mock's .clip.txt colour too. Tests: 3 new in TimelineDockTests; full suite 13396 passed. Walks: new title-and-gfx-track-icons-walk ok at Next defaults with a real capture (looked at it: Aa Title, sparkle Gfx, photo V1); library-picture-import, library-svg-logo, title-presets-library-shelf ok. Filed a-logo-or-picture-clip-on-a-gfx-track-wears-the for the mock's amber Gfx clip. Left rough (no task): shapes/arrows over video keep the layers icon, no mock covers them.

Title tracks show the text mark and Gfx tracks the sparkle (TimelineTrack.swift: preset title = .text, timed picture = new .graphic; TimelineTrackRows symbol). 3 new core tests, full suite 13396 passed; title-and-gfx-track-icons-walk ok at Next defaults with a real capture; audit 2026-10-17-title-gfx-track-icons.json.
